scope: Read-only active/committed catalogue census and deterministic stratified sample. Existing indexing rule unchanged at audit time. Supplied fields are not verified publisher/audience evidence.

storedEditorialContent.note: Presence or a state label is not independent verification. No draft is promoted by this audit.

completenessDefinition.note: Nonempty supplied fields only; not an editorial quality or verification score. Identity and price are reported separately.

samplingMethod: Replays the recorded deterministic stratified sample by ID for comparable HTML observations. Original selection: first domain-sorted record per category/country; 12 from each completeness tail; 12 metric candidates; 8 sections; 8 per price band; spaced records if fewer than 160; deduplicate by ID. Not a random or prevalence-weighted sample. Population completeness uses fresh database aggregates, never sample prevalence.

similarity.descriptionTemplate: One shared sentence pattern; host, price, supplied DR and traffic are substitutions. Unique metadata strings do not establish unique editorial information.
similarity.limitations: These initial metadata values are deterministic reconstructions of the inspected route; HTTP sample results are audited separately. Distinct requirements use an explicit >=40-character / <=3-identical-record heuristic, not a quality verdict.
